note: vespera-bridge: when a WebFlux streaming thread fails to start (thread exhaustion), every stream queued with no idle or starting thread left to take it is now rejected and frees its slot, instead of waiting (slot held) until a later stream happened to start a thread; the same applies to the replacement for a worker that died. The proxy treats such a refusal like saturation: an explicit event stream answers 503 and an implicit stream falls back to the buffered path, instead of a generic 500.
